treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Malta and the Government of Ireland for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2008)
eif_quote: that the Convention has entered into force on the 15 January, 2009.
source_title: S.L. 123.105 Double Taxation Relief on Taxes on Income with Ireland Order (Schedule: 2008 Convention and Protocol)

rates.quote: where the dividends are paid by a company which is a resident of Ireland to a resident of Malta who is the beneficial owner thereof, the Irish tax so charged shall not exceed: (i) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the voting power of the company paying the dividends;
(ii) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases;
Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Effective in Ireland for years of assessment/financial years beginning on or after 1 Jan of the year after EIF (Art. 27(a)) -> 2010-01-01; in Malta for income derived from 1 Jan 2010. Malta-source dividends (Art. 10(2)(b)): Malta tax 'shall not exceed that chargeable on the profits out of which the dividends are paid' - no fixed percentage, not modelled. 5% Irish tier: company holding directly >=10% of voting power, no holding period. Protocol relates only to Art. 22(1)(b) ('Malta tax payable'). MLI: covered; Malta reserved Art. 8; PPT effective for WHT from 2020-01-01 (merged dataset).
